queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'RStudio' AND publisher = 'Posit Software';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'RStudio' AND publisher = 'Posit Software' AND version_compare(REPLACE(version, '+', '.'), '2026.10.1.239') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) IN ('rgui.exe','rsession.exe','rstudio.exe'));
